Another strategy is one in which athletes focus on a positive thought to distract them from negative feelings of pain. The researchers believe that this kind of resistance to pain is something that can be learned over time. As athletes are often incredibly motivated to win a game or set a record in their event, they seem to be more likely to adopt these techniques.
